item.title: Ontologies in Knowledge Graphs: Reasoning and Validation
item.description: A practical guide to ontology design in knowledge graphs, including RDF, RDFS, OWL, open-world reasoning, SHACL validation, and production trade-offs.

item.title: Knowledge Graphs: Data Models, Construction, and Graph RAG
item.description: A practical guide to knowledge-graph models, identity, provenance, construction, querying, evaluation, and their role in retrieval-augmented generation.
